issue.description:
ADR-005 (Accepted, 2026-08-16) specifies a `ready_frontier` check in `doctor` under the `dependencies` scope that warns when `open` issues carry an assignee — the shape that left 583 issues unclaimable across 47 workspaces with every diagnostic reporting clean — and no open bead covers it (beadrs-892eb8ce is the separate manual_blocked surfacing; beadrs-90abfec2 is the separate blocked-count column defect). Work: warn on open+assigned issues with a bounded sample of offending ids and the exact remedy `bead update <id> --clear-assignee`; keep the check strictly advisory — doctor never clears an assignee, not even under `--repair`, because a deliberately parked reservation is indistinguishable at the schema level from abandoned residue. Tests: open+assigned warns; `in_progress` claims, closed issues, and genuinely blocked issues do not; `--repair` leaves assignment untouched on a warning-producing workspace; a healthy frontier produces no warning; verify the new check does not disturb the blocked-count query being fixed under beadrs-90abfec2.

---
Priority: P2
Created by: weave strand
issue.title: Add the advisory doctor ready_frontier check for open issues held off the frontier by assignment
